title: DSBCapture: _in situ_ single-nucleotide resolution DNA double-strand break mapping
protocol: Grow cells to 70% confluency.
Wash cells with PBS \(-/-\).
Detach cells using trypsin \(e.g., HeLa/U2OS\) or accutase \(e.g., NHEKs\).
Add an equal amount of complete growth medium to the detached cells.
Transfer cells to a Falcon tube and centrifuge at 1300 rpm for 5 min at room temperature to pellet the cells.
Remove the supernatant, re-suspend cells in complete medium and count.
Make a single cell suspension \(by pipetting up and down 10 times\) of 1 million cells/1.5 mL in DMEM 10% FBS \(maximum of 25 million cells / 50 mL Falcon tube\).
Add formaldehyde to the single cell suspension to achieve a final concentration of 2%.
Rotate \((7 rpm)\) at room temperature for 30 min.
Add 2 M glycine to achieve a final concentration of 125 mM.
Rotate \((7 rpm)\) for an additional 5 min at room temperature.
Chill samples on ice for 10 min.
Centrifuge cells at 1200 rpm for 5 min at 4 °C with the brake switched off.
Remove the supernatant.
Tap tube against hand to loosen the pellet.
Add ice cold PBS of the same volume as was removed.
Invert tube 5 times.
Centrifuge the cells at 1200 rpm for 5 minutes at 4 °C with the break switched off.
Remove the supernatant.
Tap tube against hand to loosen the pellet.
Add ice cold PBS of the same volume as was removed.
Store fixed cells in PBS at 4 °C overnight or proceed immediately to day 2.
Centrifuge cells at 1200 rpm for 5 minutes at 4 °C with the break switched off.
Remove supernatant.
Tap tube against hand to loosen the pellet.
Add chilled Lysis buffer (200 μL/10^6 cells).
Invert tube gently until the pellet is re-suspended.
Incubate for 90 min at 4 °C rotating at 7 rpm.
Centrifuge cells at 1200 rpm for 5 minutes at 4 °C with the break switched off.
Remove supernatant and tap tube against hand to loosen the pellet.
Add room temperature Nucleus Break buffer (200 μL/10^6 cells).
Invert tube gently until the pellet is re-suspended.
Incubate at 37 °C for 45 min whilst gently rotating.
Centrifuge cells at 1200 rpm for 5 minutes at room temperature with the break switched off.
Remove the supernatant, taking care not to disturb the pellet.
Add chilled 1 × NEBuffer 2 + 0.1 % Triton X-100 so that the final volume in the tube is equivalent to 10 million cells/mL.
Re-suspend by pipetting up and down and transfer nuclei to 2 ml Eppendorf tubes at a rate of 10 million nuclei/tube (i.e., 1 mL/tube).
Place samples on ice and add Proteinase K to a final concentration of 100 μg/ml.
Vortex samples briefly at minimum power and then incubate for 8 minutes at 37 °C in a water bath.
Work quickly: Place samples on ice and immediately add an equal volume of NEBuffer 2 + 0.1 % Triton X-100 + 1:50 PMSF (filter buffer through 0.2 μm filter before adding).
Invert tubes to mix.
Centrifuge samples in a bench top microcentrifuge with the hinge of the Eppendorf tube facing outwards.
Carefully remove as much supernatant as possible, leaving approximately 50 μl behind.
Check the supernatant for nuclei; if present, centrifuge again at a spin speed 1000 g greater than indicated.
Remove the supernatant and add recovered nuclei back to the original tube by adding wash buffer or reaction buffer to the pelleted nuclei before transferring back.
Ensure that the supernatant from repeated centrifugation is free from nuclei.
Check the supernatant for nuclei after each centrifugation step during wash steps.
Mix 10 μL of supernatant with 10 μL trypan blue.
Visualise nuclei using a light microscope.
Use Ibidi slides to aid in visualizing nuclei.
Centrifuge the nuclei at 1200 g for 10 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Add chilled 1 × NEBuffer 2 + 0.1% Triton X-100 (100 μL/10^6 cells).
Close tube and invert rapidly to re-suspend the pellet.
Centrifuge the nuclei at 1200 g for 10 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Add chilled 1 × NEBuffer 2 + 0.1% Triton X-100 (100 μL/10^6 cells).
Close tube and invert rapidly to re-suspend the pellet.
Centrifuge the nuclei at 1200 g for 10 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Add chilled 1 × Blunting Buffer + 100 μg/ml BSA (200 μl/10^6 nuclei).
Close tube and invert rapidly to re-suspend the pellet.
Centrifuge the nuclei at 1200 g for 10 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Add 1 × Blunting Buffer + 100 μg/ml BSA to the pellet to create a final volume of roughly 86 μl/tube.
Add 10 μl 1 mM dNTPs.
Add 4 μl Blunting Enzyme Mix.
Mix gently by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate the nuclei for 45 min at 25°C, shaking at 800 rpm for 10 sec every 5 min.
Wash the nuclei 3 times in chilled 1 × NEBuffer 2 + 0.1% Triton X-100 (100 μl/10^6 nuclei).
Centrifuge the nuclei at 2200 g for 10 min at 4 °C, between each wash and remove the supernatant.
Add chilled 1 × NEBuffer 2 without Triton X-100 (100 μl/10^6 nuclei). Close tube and invert rapidly to re-suspend the pellet.
Centrifuge the nuclei at 2200 g, remove the supernatant and leave behind approximately 50 μl. If less than 50 μl is left behind, add more 1 × NEBuffer 2 to make up to 50 μl.
Add 0.5 μl of 10 mM dATP.
Add 3 μl of Klenow Fragment exo-.
Mix gently by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate the nuclei at 37 °C for 45 min, shaking at 800 rpm for 10 sec every 10 min.
Wash the nuclei 3 times in chilled 1 × NEBuffer 2 + 0.1% Triton X-100 (100 μl/10^6 nuclei).
Centrifuge the nuclei at 2200 g for 10 min at 4 °C between each wash and remove the supernatant.
Add chilled 1 × T4 Ligase Reaction Buffer + 0.1% Triton X-100 (freshly added) (100 μl/10^6 nuclei). Close tube and invert rapidly to re-suspend the pellet.
Centrifuge nuclei at 2200 g for 10 min at 4 °C.
Remove the supernatant.
Add chilled 1 × T4 Ligase Reaction Buffer without Triton X-100 (100 μl /10^6 nuclei).
Centrifuge the nuclei at 2200 g for 10 min at 4 °C.
Remove the supernatant, leaving behind approximately 40 μl.
Add 10 μl of 10 μM modified P5 Illumina adapter.
Add 0.6 μl T4 DNA Ligase (2,000,000 units/mL).
Prepare one control without ligase (10 million nuclei).
Mix gently by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate at 16 °C for 15-20 h, shaking at 350 rpm, every 45 min for 15 sec.
Wash nuclei twice in 1 × W&B buffer + 0.1 % Triton X-100 (freshly added) (100 μl/10^6 nuclei).
Centrifuge nuclei at 3500 g for 10 min at 25 °C between each wash.
Remove the supernatant after the addition of wash buffer.
Close the tube and invert rapidly to re-suspend the pellet.
Add 1 × Lambda Exonuclease reaction buffer (50 μl/10^6 nuclei).
Close the tube and invert rapidly to re-suspend the pellet.
Centrifuge nuclei at 3500 g for 10 min at 25 °C.
Remove the supernatant.
Make volume up to 50 μl/10 million cells using 1 × Lambda Exonuclease reaction buffer.
Add 50 units of Lambda Exonuclease.
Mix gently by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Add chilled 1 × NEBuffer 2 + 0.1% Triton X-100 (100 μl/10^6 nuclei).
Close the tube and invert rapidly to re-suspend the pellet.
Centrifuge at 4500 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Add chilled 1 × NEBuffer 2 + 0.5% Triton X-100 (100 μl/10^6 nuclei).
Close the tube and invert rapidly to re-suspend the pellet.
Set aside 5 μl.
Add 20 mg/ml Proteinase K to a final concentration of 200 μg/ml.
Incubate for 30 minutes at 55°C, shaking at 800 rpm.
Incubate for 30 minutes at 65°C, shaking at 800 rpm.
Centrifuge the sample at maximum speed for 1 minute.
Place the samples on ice and divide each tube into two (500 μl per tube).
Add 214 μl 1 M potassium acetate per tube.
Vortex for 5 seconds.
Add 2 μl GlycoBlue per tube.
Vortex for 5 seconds.
Add 500 μl ice cold propan-2-ol per tube.
Vortex at maximum speed until the aqueous and organic phases have mixed.
Chill samples on ice for 20 minutes, store at -80°C overnight.
Centrifuge samples for 30 min at maximum speed, 4 °C.
Remove the supernatant.
Add 500 μl ice cold 70% ethanol per tube.
Vortex for 5 sec.
Centrifuge for 5 min at maximum speed, 4 °C.
Remove the supernatant.
Add 500 μl ice cold 70% ethanol per tube.
Vortex for 5 sec.
Centrifuge for 5 min at maximum speed, 4 °C.
Remove any remaining ethanol.
Air dry pellets.
Dissolve each pellet in 90 μl of nuclease-free water.
Incubate samples at 55 °C, shaking at 800 rpm for 1 h.
Centrifuge for 1 min at maximum speed, pool two tubes of one kind together (180 μl total).
Transfer material to a sonication tube and sonicate using the Biorupter plus on HIGH setting with parameters: 30 seconds ON; 30 seconds OFF for approximately 25 cycles.
Image 1 μl DNA on an agarose gel after 15 cycles to determine average fragment length.
Assess whether further cycles of sonication are necessary based on the desired fragment length.
Transfer DNA to LoBind Eppendorf tube once the desired fragment length has been obtained.
Quantify DNA (e.g., using a Qubit fluorimeter).
Store samples at -20 °C or proceed directly to day 6.
Work at room temperature unless specified otherwise.
Anneal the modified P7 Illumina adapter with its complement before use.
Use 5 μl Dynabeads MyOne Strepdavidin C1 per 50 μg of DNA.
Wash beads twice with 1 mL 1 × W&B buffer + 0.1% Triton X-100 (freshly added).
Add an equal volume of 2 × W&B buffer + 0.2% Triton X-100 (freshly added) to the DNA to create a 1 × final concentration.
Add the DNA to the beads (50 μg of DNA to 5 μl beads/tube, make volume up to 0.6 mL using 1 × W&B buffer + 0.1% Triton X-100 (freshly added)) and rotate at 7 rpm for 45 min at 4°C.
Place tubes onto magnetic rack to capture the beads and remove the supernatant.
Wash beads 3 × in 1 mL 1 × W&B buffer + 0.1% Triton X-100 (freshly added).
Resuspend the beads in 42 μl 1 × Blunting Buffer, add:
Add 0.8 μl 10 × Blunting Buffer.
Add 0.25 μl BSA (20 mg/mL).
Add 5 μl 1 mM dNTPs.
Add 2 μl Blunting Enzyme Mix.
Incubate for 45 min at 25°C, shaking at 800 rpm every 5 min for 10 sec.
Wash beads 3 times in 1 ml of 1 × W&B buffer + 0.1% Triton X-100.
Replace buffer immediately after removing it; do not let the beads dry.
Re-suspend sample in 23 μl of 1 × NEBuffer 2 without Triton X-100.
Add 0.5 μl of 5 mM dATP to the re-suspended sample.
Add 1.5 μl of Klenow Fragment exo- to the sample.
Incubate at 37 °C for 45 minutes, shaking for 10 seconds every 10 minutes at 800 rpm.
Wash beads 3 times in 1 ml of 1 × W&B buffer + 0.1% Triton X-100.
Replace buffer immediately after removing it; do not let the beads dry.
Re-suspend sample in 39.4 μl of 1 × T4 Ligase Reaction Buffer.
Add 10 μl of 10 μM modified P7 Illumina adapter to the re-suspended sample.
Add 0.6 μl of T4 DNA Ligase (2,000,000 units/mL) to the sample.
Ligate for 15-20 hours at 16 °C, shaking samples for 1 minute every 45 minutes at 1200 rpm.
Wash beads 3 times in 1 ml of W&B buffer + 0.1% Triton X-100 at room temperature.
Replace buffer immediately after removing it; do not let the beads dry.
Re-suspend beads in 25 μl of nuclease-free water.
Place samples on ice.
Perform PCR: each 25 μl sample will make up 5 reactions.
Mix 1.25 μl 20 μM F primer with PCR reagents.
Mix 1.25 μl 20 μM R primer with PCR reagents.
Add 5 μl beads to the mixture.
Add 17.5 μl nuclease-free water to the mixture.
Add 25 μl NEBNext High-Fidelity 2 × Master Mix to the mixture.
Pipette sample up and down after adding all reagents.
Incubate at 98 °C for 30 seconds.
Incubate at 98 °C for 10 seconds.
Incubate at 65 °C for 30 seconds.
Incubate at 72 °C for 30 seconds.
Repeat steps from incubating at 98 °C for 10 seconds, 14 times.
Incubate at 72 °C for 5 minutes after the last cycle.
Centrifuge to pellet beads and recover PCR product (supernatant).
Store PCR product at -80°C or proceed directly to day 8.
Pass the PCR sample through a Qiagen MinElute PCR clean up column (100 μl PCR product/column).
Load the cleaned-up sample into the BluePippin gel extraction system (1.5% agarose cassette).
Extract 250-1200 bp from the gel.
Alternatively, omit the PCR clean-up step and directly load the PCR product onto a 2% hand-cast agarose gel.
Manually extract the band at 250-1200 bp.
Clean up the DNA using a Qiagen MinElute gel extraction kit.
Run the sample on a Bioanalyser or TapeStation (high sensitivity chip) to determine the library size.
Quantify the DNA using the KAPA Library Quantification Kit.
Proceed to sequencing and store excess DNA at -20°C.
